scope: Complete compact exact delta review; captured C has already been read by the requesting root, but this artifact claims no root review.
read_order: Read manifest_v01.json, this index, all numbered review_v02 JSONL files in order, both complete text diffs, and replay_v01.json.

row_schemas.C: ["C", pool_number, exact_captured_numeric_JSON_pointer]. The node at that captured pointer, encoded by the manifest codec, exactly equals pool node V%04d for pool_number. The complete equality was checked; choose the shortest literal pointer deterministically among exact matches.
row_schemas.V: ["V", pool_number, complete_exact_novel_codec_node]. Every node absent from the captured report node pool appears here in full exactly once.
row_schemas.P: ["P", new_pool_number_or_null, old_pool_number_or_null, record_numbers, suffix_numbers]. Every Cartesian product record-prefix + suffix is exactly one original operation with those old/new pool nodes. Null new means deletion; null old means addition. The product equality and lack of duplicate paths were checked over all operations.

pool_number_rule: Integer n denotes the full v01 pool id V%04d formatted with n; it is an exact numeric alias, not a source value.
pointer_rule: RFC6901 escaping; /differences/@ID uses the exact source id. Replace @ID by old_index or new_index from difference_permutation to obtain the numeric pointer. Every other logical path is already a numeric JSON pointer. A missing old_node or new_node has a null corresponding pointer.
value_scope: All role, hand, attachment, candidate, and container fields are retained through exact nodes and paths. Exact references retain their captured source values. Complete candidates are recovered by ordered object/array nodes plus all descendant values. The procedure performs no consistency repair or attribution transfer.
